digest.component_or_area: CLI author guides and commit-trailer discovery
propositions: Clients using rebar CLI without a repo checkout encounter dead internal cross-references in packaged guides because they use consumer-relative paths instead of absolute or CLI-discoverable references.
The commit-trailer format EXPECTED_FORMAT has no CLI-discoverable home; it is only documented in verify_commit_ticket help and nothing points there.

Packaged author guides must repoint all dangling references to use either sibling guide invocations (rebar explain <topic>) or canonical hosted URLs (https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/...), never repo-relative paths.

A comprehensive regression guard test must enforce that no packaged guide markdown contains consumer-relative link targets or bare repo paths, allowing only https://, http://, #anchors, or rebar explain invocations.
